mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, we are looking at overcast skies at Harriet Park. Tonight, look up at 9:37 PM to see the International Space Station passing from Cross Plains toward Oregon, reaching about halfway up the sky.

The City of Verona is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for K-12 students. Submissions are due by July 22, and the community will vote on the designs from July 28 through August 7 to choose the winners for our November election stickers.

We have a busy schedule today with the Dane County Farmers Market downtown, plus live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Louie this coming Tuesday.
On July 15, police were called to Prairie Oaks Drive regarding a domestic disturbance, which resulted in a 30-year-old Verona man being arrested for felony bail jumping.
You have plenty of time to satisfy your sweet tooth today with Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough, as Culvers remains open until 10:30 PM.
